Move an object to a different directory/kind while preserving history.



This command allows reorganizing objects while maintaining system integrity:

- Preserves created_at, created_by, and other history fields

- Updates hash registry atomically

- Creates audit event for move operation

- Optionally updates references pointing to the moved object

  Move a backlog item to goal kind
  zqk object move BLI-001 --kind goal
  Move and update references
  zqk object move BLI-001 --kind goal --update-references
  Dry-run to see what would happen
  zqk object move BLI-001 --kind goal --dry-run

Usage:
  zqk object move [flags]

Flags:
      --kind string                      Target kind to move the object to
      --update-references[=true|false]   Update references pointing to the moved object

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded[=true|false]   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
      --internal[=true|false]         Elevated access mode for built-in and internal kinds (requires Enterprise license or zqk-admin)
